title: The Hand That Never Lets Go

scenes.narration: Dear love, I know you're used to people who walk away when things get hard.
scenes.image_query: Dear love, I know you're used to people who walk away when things get hard.

scenes.narration: But I will be the one who stays.
scenes.image_query: But I will be the one who stays.

scenes.narration: I'll become the quiet reminder that you are deeply wanted, exactly as you are today.
scenes.image_query: I'll become the quiet reminder that you are deeply wanted, exactly as you are today.

scenes.narration: I'll become the hand that never lets go of yours.
scenes.image_query: I'll become the hand that never lets go of yours.

scenes.narration: Not just for a season, but for a lifetime.
scenes.image_query: Not just for a season, but for a lifetime.

scenes.narration: And this is my promise to you.
scenes.image_query: And this is my promise to you.
